name: Grand Duchy of Lithuania
description: A red banner, its fly cut in a stepped tail, bearing the Vytis: an armoured knight on a charging horse, sword raised.
history: The royal banner of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, attested from the late 14th century. The Vytis remains Lithuania's state emblem and the basis of its state flag.

features.role: the Vytis — mounted armoured knight with raised sword
features.symbolism: the charging pursuer (vytis), emblem of Lithuania since the 14th century
